_purpose: Machine-checkable boundary between LIVE conversational Workday path tests (protect) and DELETED autonomous-resident tests (safe-to-cut / restore-on-restore). Future test-estate cut subtasks must not touch PROTECT entries without operator sign-off.

protect.reason: Covers the agent-side message-poll endpoint (GET /api/agent/projects/{id}/messages) — the inbound operator-to-agent channel for the conversational Workday session. Removing this leaves zero test coverage on the agent message delivery contract.

The listed test_ids are the session/conversation-specific ones; other tests in the file cover orthogonal surfaces and may be pruned independently.

Covers the operator message-create endpoint (POST /api/admin/projects/{id}/strategic-session/messages), session settings persistence, and workbench-state session_started_at decay — all live conversational-Workday contracts.
Covers the agent-side message-create and message-fetch endpoints used during a conversational Workday session (POST and GET under /api/agent/projects/{id}/strategic/*).

Primary protection for conversational Workday seams — invariant tests covering session availability, arming suppression, retry/refresh binding, operator-send serialization, mutation fencing, terminal reconciliation, and work-session arming. Exact test list is machine-enforced by test_workday_invariant_suite_is_protected_with_all_tests; silently deleting or emptying this file would remove all invariant coverage without tripping any existing guard.

Covers the core conversational Workday session lifecycle — start/adopt, liveness heartbeat/lease, stop/handoff, and message handoff. These are the primary backend seams for the operator-driven Workday session; deleting this file would leave the session start/stop/handoff contract completely untested.

Covers handleStrategicResident — the agent-side handler that drives the conversational Workday session loop (operator reply, compaction restart, workspace recovery, corrective tick, provider-error guard). This is the deepest coverage of the resident session path on the agent side; deleting it leaves the handler entirely untested.
